newsitem.title: UK: ICI jumps on news of chemical unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: ICI jumps on news of chemical unit purchase.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc jumped to a two-month high on Wednesday following news that it bought Unilever Plc's international speciality chemicals unit.
ICI shares were up 43-1/2p to 758 at 0800 GMT.
ICI purchased the businesses for $8.0 billion in cash.
Unilever said the sale would result in an exceptional gain, before tax and expenses, of more than $5.0 billion.
"ICI is saying the deal will be neutral or positive for earnings in the first year...longer term, it's good for ICI because it makes it less dependent on bulk chemicals," said one London dealer.
Another dealer added that the market was impressed that the company was taking steps to shift its strategy toward speciality chemicals.
"ICI (stock) has been in the doldrums for some time now and they needed to do something to lift the price," he said. "This is very good news for them."
He said the purchase price was on the lower end on expectations.
